topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of inflammation and frames the scope and approach of the lecture.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition of infection and cellular damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system detects pathogens and cellular damage to initiate immune activation.

topics.label: Cellular and vascular mechanisms of the inflammatory response
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular, vascular, and systemic processes that recruit immune cells and execute the inflammatory response.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation and tissue repair
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammation is brought to resolution and how tissues are repaired or structurally adapted when inflammation persists.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic of the next lecture.
